integrity: Complete uniform nine-phase elementary free-face proof; standalone finite checks corroborate but do not replace the all-parameter argument. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The collapse theorem is for the 2n discrete vertex set of C_n square K_2, n>=7, with inclusive shortest-path distance <=2. Other n, thresholds, and the continuous metric graph are not addressed. Literature-search coverage is not absolute.
source_ids: Sterling 2025 Auburn thesis: Vietoris-Rips Complexes of Torus Grids
title: Scale-two Rips complexes of circular ladder vertices collapse to a rim
